task: Read-only source and live-scene audit of missing teaching-left stairs
scope: No UE operations. No edits to .blend, .fbx, .uasset or map. Only audit scripts and JSON written under work/research/teaching_left_stair_20261108.

conclusion.cause: The left stair was intentionally stripped during the 2026-11-07 unverified-structure removal. Current source and live scene both contain only its exterior shell. It is not a temporary visibility or loading failure.
conclusion.old_geometry_provenance: The previous WestStair was a copy of GreenStair shifted 45 metres. It was not independently derived from left-stair photographs or measurements.
conclusion.reality_limit: Source dimensions and current storey elevations are model values, not real-world measurements. Video facts must independently establish stairs, direction, location, tread counts and floor coverage.

which_end_is_left.reason: WestStair projects approximately 4,490 cm to the left of GreenStair in the saved current user viewpoint.

coordinate_system.input: teaching-local metres from build_walkthrough.py, before wing() and site()
coordinate_system.mesh_actor_transform: Relevant current mesh actors have identity location/rotation/scale because vertices are already in world coordinates.

geometry_and_openings.source_window_module: Six repeated rear windows, still estimated exterior shell; model alone does not prove their real-world count/size.
geometry_and_openings.classroom1_each_level: x=52..61, y=33..42.2; nearest classroom wall is x=51.91..52.09.
geometry_and_openings.no_internal_floorplates: Current WestStair has no floor or landing plates at any level. No shaft floor cutting is required before adding a confirmed limited stair portion.
geometry_and_openings.connection_gap: Old full landing started at y=34.5; current corridor ends at y=33.0. At least 1.5 m of the old approach was covered by a separate conjectural connecting slab that was also removed.
geometry_and_openings.removed_old_stairs: Two flights of 10 risers, 0.175 m rise, 0.3 m run and 2.2 m width per storey, repeated six times. These are prior invented parameters, not recommended reconstruction dimensions.
geometry_and_openings.old_duplicate_faces: Old GreyTile landing mesh contains duplicated full landings at intermediate storeys (two identical disconnected boxes at each of 1..5/F). Direct old-asset restoration would reintroduce coincident faces.

lowest_risk_work.action: Add only a separately authored video-confirmed stair portion, isolated from the old repeated assets.
lowest_risk_work.condition: Independent evidence must identify left-end location and the specific floor span. Match the retained model only where a connection is confirmed; document dimensions as estimates unless measured.

lowest_risk_work.action: Open or resize only the matching left invisible boundary after a continuous floor/stair path has been built and tested.
lowest_risk_work.condition: Do not remove all 14 teaching stair boundaries globally. Left boundaries are Teaching stair 49 floor 0..6.

lowest_risk_work.action: Test for falling off the existing corridor left edge before calling the access boundary safe.
lowest_risk_work.condition: Existing blocker is at y=33.05; corridor lateral edge is x=51,y=30.8..33. It does not itself guard that entire side. Use collision traces/live walk test to distinguish the actual current route from source geometry alone.

lowest_risk_work.action: If an evidence-confirmed partial stair is added, keep the unsupported continuation inaccessible without adding visible invented physical barriers.
lowest_risk_work.condition: User specifically rejected unsupported interiors and previously said there is no guardrail near the left stairs.

potential_minimal_left_only_update.precondition: No mutation is recommended until video placement and covered floor interval are established. This is a scoping envelope, not a proposed wholesale restoration.
potential_minimal_left_only_update.new_assets: Create dedicated left-stair geometry assets; do not reimport full ATS_Walkthrough.fbx or overwrite shared/retired staircase assets.

required_invariants: All dining actors and current dining reconstruction
All 24 retained classroom interiors and front doors
All right-stair shell actors and seven right-stair boundaries
Current camera unless deliberately showing the finished left repair

not_safe_to_infer: Do not duplicate the right stair at the left: the old source did exactly that and both videos may depict different tread finishes.
Do not reinstate six identical storey modules merely because six classroom floors exist.
Do not infer which stair video belongs to the left from material colour alone.
Do not infer physical G-floor entrance configuration from the upper-floor user annotation for the right stair.
Do not treat current shell width, height, back windows or corridor-to-stair gap as measured school dimensions.
Do not add a new visible landing guardrail solely to make the model safe.

visual_orientation_clues_only.expected_landmarks: Model left-end front view is toward the historic long wing west end/cross-wing court region; right-end front view approaches the right-side newer block. This is a model-based hypothesis to test against frames, not a real-world placement proof.
